integrity: The proof is derived directly from the published DPITL survival discretization. The target's moment formulas and Table 1 were inspected in the open-access PDF, and the continuous PITL precursor was inspected in full text. Numerical calculations only replay the asymptotic formulas and are not used to prove convergence or divergence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies moment existence but does not provide new closed forms for moments inside the finite region.
The dispersion sign is not classified within the finite-variance region; only the necessary domain for a finite dispersion index is established.
The continuous precursor may contain convergence restrictions implicit in special-function formulas, but no explicit discrete DPITL phase theorem was located.
title: Sharp moment phase diagram for DPITL invalidates four published summary rows
